title: Zesty Middle Eastern Pork Tenderloin Fattoush
description: A flavorful and refreshing Middle Eastern dish featuring grilled pork tenderloin, mixed greens, and toasted pita bread, all tied together with a zesty tahini dressing. This recipe is perfect for a cozy dinner or lunch.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the pork tenderloin with sumac, salt, and pepper.
Grill the pork tenderloin for 5 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Let the pork rest for 5 minutes before slicing it thinly.
In a large bowl, combine the mixed greens, toasted pita bread, and sliced pork tenderloin.
In a small bowl, whisk together the tahini, lemon juice, garlic, and olive oil to make the dressing.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
